justification: GST-3298 PR 2 no-loss replay (CREW rule 15): deterministic, no paid run. lib/review-exclude.ts adds the content kind 'vendored': a file a review_exclude_paths pattern matches that the base policy's review_vendored verifies byte for byte (lib/review-vendored.ts vendoredSelection, read from the cache offline; gstack-review-plan fills it) is content instead of code, and a re-pin's deleted file verified at the merge base's pin is too. Every other keep reason (policy-dir, gate-path, executable, link, gate-tagged, agent-prose, config, secret-line, named-by-code) runs unchanged, gate-tagged vendored files are excerpted only off the gate floor as #4574 does for data, and list_sha256 gains a vendored digest only when a file verified, so a repo without review_vendored hashes byte for byte as before. Reviewer prompts and briefs are unchanged except one disclosure sentence when vendored files were excluded. Replay (GStack Minder drive handoffs/GST-3298/replay.ts, rows replay-rows.jsonl): reviewExclude from main 69ad103's lib/review-exclude.ts and from this branch on each first-parent commit's collectCommit input (parent as base, gate scan an empty set on both sides): gstack 56 (shallow checkout; gstack declares no review_exclude_paths), harness-evals 60 to HEAD (63 patterns), gstack-evals 100 to HEAD (10 patterns). 216 of 216 identical, 134 of them active selections. None declares review_vendored, so no selection moved. The intended change is harness-evals#504 (head 24a377ab with tests unpacked, base policy with review_vendored and the two verifier subtrees excluded, #4574's real gate scan through gstack-review-plan): main refuses REVIEW_EXCLUDE_KEEP_TOO_LARGE; this branch verifies 1,054 of 1,056 (2 mode failures stay kept), excludes 880 files (vendored 877, binary 1, data 2; 4.47 MB) and keeps 176 (166 gate-tagged: 161 upstream test files kept whole at 5.83 MB on the gate floor and 5 pyproject.toml files excerpted; 5 agent-prose, 3 config, 2 executable; recounted from the plan's kept list and git blob sizes), so #504 stays over the 2 MB reader limit. The empty-gate-scan replay of #504 excludes 1,046, every one a verified vendored file or data, and newly keeps the 10 files whose keep rules (agent prose, config, executable, mode) a verified kind does not lift.
